advisory.heading: When you select the words and the tone
advisory.text: Each rule starts with its tier.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md, line 3 tells that each rule starts with its tier, but the rules on line 11 ("Select the Skills folder of the project first"), line 50 ("When the user gives text for the description, keep the meaning of that text."), and line 73 ("If the project has 2 or more of these folders, or none of these folders, ask the user one time which folder to use.") do not start with a tier.
advisory.correction: Add the tier at the start of each of these rules, for example "Tier 4: When the user gives text for the description, keep the meaning of that text." Or change line 3 to "Each rule in a list starts with its tier."

advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: Before you select the Skills folder of the project, find the target platforms as `loading-rules.md` tells you.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md, line 73 gives a sequence of steps (find the target platforms, use the Skills folder, ask the user, add a warning) in one paragraph, not in a numbered list.
advisory.correction:
"1. Before you select the Skills folder of the project, find the target platforms as `loading-rules.md` tells you.
2. Tier 1: When the target platforms include Claude Code and Codex, use the Skills folder of the project. A Skills folder of the project is a folder from this table that the project has. A `.claude/` folder without a `skills/` folder is not a Skills folder.
3. If the project has 2 or more of these folders, or none of these folders, ask the user one time which folder to use.
4. For each Skill that you write for these target platforms, add a warning that gives the platform that does not load the Skill. (advisory)"

advisory.heading: When you select the text
advisory.text: The word rules are not applicable to quoted text, and it counts as 1 word.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md, line 53 gives facts that the pointer target ste-rules.md already gives on line 13 (the word rules are not applicable to user phrases in quotation marks) and on line 82 (quoted text counts as 1 word).
advisory.correction: Remove the sentence "The word rules are not applicable to quoted text, and it counts as 1 word." from line 53.
